Amar Kalkundrikar is the Current Fund Manager of HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹9,34,076 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 30 Oct 2026 is ₹1,434.92.

The scheme seeks to generate capital appreciation / income from a portfolio, comprising predominantly of equity & equity related instruments.
